scope: Exactly the 24 obligations labelled existing_case; no case, expectation, ledger, oracle, or source mutation.

obligations.premises: Same SOS identity for x^2+1; EMPTY is requested over R and C; ordered reach is present only at R.
obligations.attempt: Mint EMPTY over the target field from the SOS receipt.
obligations.mechanism: ordered-field reach, not polynomial equality alone

obligations.premises: The only work entry ended TIMEOUT, CAP, or BUDGET without a successful retry.
obligations.attempt: Treat the unfinished attempt as a current checked warrant.
obligations.mechanism: absence of completed verification

obligations.premises: An ordered triangular solve chain needs its ordered prior states and unit inverses.
obligations.attempt: Accept the exact chain.
obligations.mechanism: ordered substitution and exact inverse identity

obligations.premises: Each output equation must have source-ideal membership; producer metadata is supplementary.
obligations.attempt: Admit target-output membership evidence, without completeness.
obligations.mechanism: exact membership controls no-invention only
obligations.limit: The positive payload is exact, but the cited false-membership refusal currently observes ACCEPT for X260 rather than its REFUSE expectation.

obligations.premises: A certificate is attached only after exact output membership agrees.
obligations.attempt: Admit the attached output evidence.
obligations.mechanism: receipt attachment follows membership, not producer labeling
obligations.limit: The same negative membership control is an unresolved known difference.

obligations.premises: The checker decides output membership; a producer candidate cannot override it.
obligations.attempt: Admit output evidence as source-ideal membership.
obligations.mechanism: checked identity versus producer assertion
obligations.limit: GP-X260 supplies the needed false-cofactor payload but its recorded observation does not yet refuse.

obligations.premises: Listed branches are empty but no authenticated exhaustive cover is supplied.
obligations.attempt: Conclude the parent is EMPTY.
obligations.mechanism: cover premise is necessary independently of branch data

obligations.premises: Coverage is evaluated on declared loci, including open guards and selected roots.
obligations.attempt: Accept an exhaustive parent cover from ideal-only branch data.
obligations.route: partition_verification/partition_guards or partition_embeddings; X269/X271/X272/X273 AGREE, X270/X274 KNOWN_DIFFERENCE
obligations.mechanism: punctures and selected embeddings are part of the locus
obligations.limit: The payload family is exact, but both cited negative controls presently observe ACCEPT instead of REFUSE.

obligations.premises: A structured successful computation names a source model that does not exist.
obligations.attempt: Record the produced model and typed computation.
obligations.mechanism: late source-existence validation

obligations.premises: A warning review has id and reason but no meaning fingerprint.
obligations.attempt: Suppress the warning and continue operationally.
obligations.mechanism: review must bind reviewed meaning

obligations.premises: Typed structured computation recording depends on complete, error-free process outcome.
obligations.attempt: Record a produced model without inferring mathematical truth.
obligations.mechanism: omitted declaration, reported error, nonzero exit, and abort are distinct refusal inputs

obligations.premises: Coordinate-ring contraction is exact but there is no geometric image-closure or point-lifting authority.
obligations.attempt: Transport a closed/image predicate from contraction alone.
obligations.mechanism: algebraic contraction and geometric closure are separate authorities

obligations.premises: An SOS equality is evaluated over an unordered Gaussian target versus an ordered real target.
obligations.attempt: Conclude EMPTY at each target.
obligations.mechanism: ordered interpretation is load-bearing

obligations.premises: Ordered SOS EMPTY needs ordered reach, a true cofactor, and evidence bound to the target model.
obligations.attempt: Record ordered-field emptiness.
obligations.mechanism: reach plus exact arithmetic and model binding
obligations.limit: The batch's valid-square comparator remains sample-specific and is not used as a general reuse claim.

obligations.premises: A smaller open/source locus is empty while the parent retains an omitted closed locus.
obligations.attempt: Conclude parent EMPTY along inclusion.
obligations.mechanism: open-locus emptiness does not cover parent

obligations.premises: A relaxed target has a point but no checked preimage in the actual-source locus.
obligations.attempt: Lift target existence back to source existence.
obligations.mechanism: reverse realization requires a lift warrant

obligations.premises: A universal identity is true only because a smaller locus carries x=0; relaxation drops that equation.
obligations.attempt: Carry the derived universal identity ALONG to the ambient line.
obligations.mechanism: lost defining equation
obligations.limit: GP-A13-ambient is a positive control for an identity already ambient and therefore transportable. It supplies the opposite premise and cannot refuse this derived-identity transport.
obligations.proposal: Extract a minimal REFUSE pair with source ideal (x), ambient target (0), identity x=0 marked DERIVED, and a target witness x=1; retain GP-A13-ambient as its positive control.

obligations.premises: The statement explicitly separates three valid directions: witness forward along inclusion, EMPTY backward along inclusion, and EMPTY from an authenticated all-empty cover.
obligations.attempt: Apply each stated valid direction only under its own premise.
obligations.mechanism: three separate sound directions, not a generalized inclusion rule

obligations.premises: A chosen closure/relaxed target point lacks a checked source preimage.
obligations.attempt: Lift that selected point to a source realization.
obligations.mechanism: specific lift requires a preimage warrant

obligations.premises: A nilpotent vanishes on reduced points/radical observation but remains nonzero in the quotient ring.
obligations.attempt: Infer ordinary ideal membership or pull back an identity.
obligations.mechanism: radical/point evidence is weaker than ideal membership
obligations.limit: The payload and mathematical countermodel match, but GP-A03a has no executable observed verdict and remains diagnostic-only.

obligations.premises: Only a field-relative rational-root exclusion is supplied; no base-change-stable certificate exists.
obligations.attempt: Carry EMPTY to arbitrary characteristic-zero extensions.
obligations.mechanism: base-change reach is required

obligations.premises: Proposed any-field branch cover omits declared open guards or selected embeddings.
obligations.attempt: Accept exhaustive coverage from the ideal-only prose.
obligations.route: partition_verification/partition_guards or partition_embeddings; X269/X273 AGREE, X270/X274 KNOWN_DIFFERENCE
obligations.mechanism: cover semantics include guards and selected roots
obligations.limit: The two exact negative payloads are present but have known-difference ACCEPT observations, so this cannot close their refusal coverage.

obligations.premises: Parent EMPTY requires both an authenticated exhaustive cover and empty branches.
obligations.attempt: Conclude parent EMPTY.
obligations.mechanism: cover authenticity plus branch emptiness
obligations.limit: The Lean theorem assumes the cover; the payload pair tests its presence or absence at the oracle boundary.

obligations.premises: An element is zero on reduced points/radical quotient but nonzero modulo a nonreduced ideal.
obligations.attempt: Infer ordinary ideal membership from radical/point-level membership.
obligations.mechanism: nilpotent radical-versus-ideal distinction
obligations.limit: Same mathematical mechanism as the Int (4) countermodel, but the existing case is diagnostic-only rather than an executable refusal.

adjudication_note: The classifications are a review of proposed reuse, not a change to the source overlay. Existing case payloads with KNOWN_DIFFERENCE or DIAGNOSTIC_OBSERVED observations are retained as evidence but not promoted to complete oracle coverage.
